schema.reply: runtime reply, normalized with ' '.join(str(reply).split()) as in pybot.py
schema.module: winning module name (None when no module proposed / fallback)
schema.candidates: [{module, priority}] in arbiter order (replies omitted to keep the file small)
schema.memory_keys: sorted keys of the post-turn memory
schema.memory_digest: sha1 of the canonical JSON of the FULL post-turn memory
schema.memory: post-turn memory minus turns/ and understood/, values truncated to 400 chars
